About Our Brand and Products

JLM Marine is a factory-direct marine parts manufacturer with over 20 years’ experience in delivering high-quality outboard and marine engine replacement parts worldwide. Our product catalog includes cooling systems, fuel & induction systems, lubrication systems, electrical components, seals & gaskets, impellers, pumps, and many more, compatible with major brands such as Yamaha, Mercury, Johnson & Evinrude, Volvo Penta, etc.  

We pride ourselves on competitive pricing, rigorous quality control, and global shipping/logistics that serve customers in over 190 countries.  

What Makes Us Different

  • Direct-from-Factory Advantage: We manufacture many parts ourselves or work closely with vetted factories—no unnecessary middlemen—allowing us to offer premium quality at better margins.  

  • Broad Compatibility & Model Support: Our parts are designed to replace OEM units and often cross-compatible across engine makes/models. We also provide detailed serial/model number guides, parts catalogs, and “Outboard-101” type resources to help customers identify exactly what they need.  

  • Vast Product Selection & Reliable Inventory: We carry thousands of marine parts; we work hard to maintain good inventory levels so parts are ready to ship. Our shipping speed and on-time delivery statistics are strong.  

  • Transparent Customer Support: Technical support, clear product descriptions, and warranty/return policies make it easy for customers and for you (our affiliates) to recommend our brand with confidence.

How to Promote Us

Here are some of the best ways you can generate sales / referrals:

  • Content creation: create blog posts, videos, or tutorials showing how to diagnose or fix common outboard engine problems (e.g. fuel pump replacements, impeller failures) and include your affiliate link or code.

  • Review & comparison: compare OEM vs replacement parts, show side-by-side quality, cost savings, fitment & install tips.

  • Social media: sharing posts / reels / short videos on platforms like Instagram, TikTok, YouTube showing “before & after”, “how we fixed X”, “what to buy when your …” etc. Use your affiliate code/link.

  • Community & Forums: participate in boating, marine, fishing, outboard repair forums, Facebook groups, Reddit threads, where people ask “what part do I need?” or “where to buy spare parts”. Share solutions + your affiliate link.

  • Existing customers & service shops: if you work with repair shops or have satisfied customers, invite them to become affiliates. They often have local credibility.
